title: Set the credible horizon and control response
description: Extend the imagined rollout, compare control policies, and watch model error and uncertainty change the release decision.

policies.label: Open-loop execution
policies.detail: Execute the imagined sequence without correcting from new observations.

policies.label: Receding-horizon control
policies.detail: Execute the first action, observe reality, and optimize again.

policies.label: Uncertainty-gated control
policies.detail: Replan early and reject trajectories whose disagreement crosses the gate.

scenarios.label: Blind warehouse turn
scenarios.context: Short contact-sensitive navigation with frequent observations.
scenarios.fallback: slow to inspection speed and request a fresh depth frame

scenarios.label: Rough-terrain traverse
scenarios.context: Friction and contact dynamics differ from most training trajectories.
scenarios.fallback: return to the last stable foothold and switch to the conservative gait

scenarios.label: Inventory routing policy
scenarios.context: A slower digital process with delayed demand evidence and reversible decisions.
scenarios.fallback: cap the allocation change and wait for the next observed demand window
